summary: IDS feed s071_single is degraded: 100% of packets are untagged and required VLANs 10, 20 are completely absent. All other checks (duplicates, encrypted share, one-way, drops, overload) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker / SPAN/TAP trunk is stripping 802.1Q tags before delivery to the IDS. 100% untagged with 0% of required VLANs 10, 20 seen indicates systematic tag stripping or access-port handoff instead of trunk passthrough, not random loss.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS cannot segment or apply VLAN-aware detection for VLANs 10 and 20; traffic that should be classified to those VLANs is invisible/untagged, so detection coverage for those segments is effectively zero despite IDS needing full payload and both directions.

recommended_fix.why: Enable 802.1Q tag preservation/passthrough on the packet broker ingress and egress to the IDS so VLANs 10 and 20 are delivered intact for correct classification and detection.
